mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 0 and UNRATE < 0.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, which can lead to lower equity valuations and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflation, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 0 and CPIAUCSL > 0.
